subject.title: fix(google): bound SSE stream body reads at 16 MiB

question: Should Google and Vertex SSE success bodies fail closed once the streamed response exceeds 16 MiB?
rationale: The cap matches sibling stream safety ceilings and closes an OOM class, but it intentionally changes behavior for any existing oversized Google or Vertex stream.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Land the narrow provider-local guard with the same 16 MiB fail-closed threshold used by sibling stream readers.

options.title: Hold for stream-limit policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a different threshold, an SDK subpath first, or a compatibility strategy before changing Google streaming behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the narrow provider-local guard with the same 16 MiB fail-closed threshold used by sibling stream readers.
